# This workbook contains code to integrate pre-cleaned chlorophyll data. See 01-prefixed notebooks for cleaning steps.

## Load Packages
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)
library(ggplot2)
library(plotly)
library(sf)
library(leaflet)
library(leaflet.extras2)
library(scales)
library(crosstalk)
library(geojsonsf)
library(jsonlite)
```

## Read in data and keep only dates that fall within the range of continous monitoring data

```{r}
#Continuous monitoring
cm_data <- read.csv("data//01_processed//01_chl_cm_daytime_avg.csv")
cm_data <- cm_data %>% select(-X)
maxdate <- as.Date(max(cm_data$date))
mindate <- as.Date(min(cm_data$date))

#ScienceBase
sb_data_1 <- read.csv("data//01_processed//01_Bay_chl_sciencebase.csv")
sb_data_2 <- read.csv("data//01_processed//01_Delta_chl_2020onward_sciencebase.csv")
sb_data_3 <- read.csv("data//01_processed//01_Delta_chl_pre2020_sciencebase.csv")

sb_data <- rbind(sb_data_1, sb_data_2, sb_data_3)

rm(sb_data_1, sb_data_2, sb_data_3)

sb_data <- sb_data %>% 
    mutate(date = as.Date(datetime),
    group = "usgs") %>%
    filter(between(date, mindate, maxdate))

#EMP

iep_data <- read.csv("data//01_processed//01_chl_iep.csv")
iep_data <- iep_data %>% 
  mutate(date = as.Date(date))%>%
  filter(between(date, mindate, maxdate))

#EDI
## TBD

rm(mindate, maxdate)
```

## Combine the data

```{r}
cm_data <- cm_data %>% 
    rename(sample_type = instrument,
    chl_ugl = avg_fchl) %>%
    mutate(date = as.Date(date),
    chl_ugl = round(chl_ugl, 2)) %>% 
    distinct()

sb_data <- sb_data %>%
    select(-datetime) %>%
    mutate(station = NA)%>%
    distinct()

ieprmks <- iep_data %>% filter (!is.na(chla_rmk)) %>% select(chla_rmk, group) %>% distinct() #"<" means below reporting limit, changed to reporting limit. "=" means value unedited. All good to keep here. 

iep_data <- iep_data %>%
    filter(is.na(depth)| depth <=2) %>%
    select(-datetime, -X, -depth, -chla_rmk) %>%
    rename(chl_ugl = chla)%>%     
    mutate(chl_ugl = round(chl_ugl, 2)) %>% 
    distinct()

chl_data <- rbind(cm_data, sb_data, iep_data)
rm(cm_data, sb_data, ieprmks, iep_data)

chl_data <- chl_data %>% filter(!is.na(latitude)) %>% filter(!is.na(longitude)) %>% filter(!is.na(chl_ugl)) %>% distinct()
```

# Further clean and add lab info
```{r}
chl_data <- chl_data %>% mutate(group = case_when(
    group == "dwr_rtm" ~ "dwr_cemp",
    group == "dwr_ncro" ~ "dwr_ncro",
    group == "NCRO" ~ "dwr_ncro",
    group == "usgs" ~ "usgs_cawsc",
    group == "USGS_CAWSC" ~ "usgs_cawsc",
    group == "DOP" ~ "usbr",
    group == "EMP" ~ "dwr_demp",
    group == "USGS_SFBS" ~ "usgs_bay"
  )) %>%
  mutate(lab = case_when(
    group == "dwr_cemp" ~ "bryte",
    group == "dwr_ncro"~ "bryte",
    group == "usgs_cawsc" ~ "nwql_cbl",
    group == "usbr" ~ "ucd",
    group == "dwr_demp"~ "bryte",
    group == "usgs_bay" ~ "menlo"
  ))
```

# Create bespoke dataset for lab data comparison (00 prefixed notebook)

```{r}
chl_data <- chl_data %>%
  arrange(date) %>%
  mutate(sample_id = row_number())

#locs just for ArcPro
ds_chl <- chl_data %>% filter(sample_type == "discrete") 

ds_locs <- ds_chl %>% 
  select(sample_id, latitude, longitude)
  # export for ArcPro Analysis

write.csv(ds_locs, "data\\bespoke_datasets\\ds_locs_20261023ER.csv")

# Create sensor-only dataset
sensor_chl <- chl_data %>% filter(!sample_type == "discrete")

#locs just for ArcPro
sensor_locs <- sensor_chl %>% select(sample_id, latitude, longitude)

write.csv(sensor_locs, "data\\bespoke_datasets\\sensor_locs20261023ER.csv")
```

```{r}
# After Arcpro nearest spatial neightbors analysis, filter by near time, join in metadata












# Join in discrete that match sensor by time and location to compare. All labs except UCD (USBR DOP data) were comparable, granted concentration was relatively low.
chl_comparison_df <- inner_join(ds_chl, sensor_chl, join_by(group, date, station)) %>% 
  select(date, station, latitude.x, longitude.x, group, chl_ugl.x, chl_ugl.y, sample_type.y, lab.x) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(station)) %>%
  rename(longitude = longitude.x, 
  latitude = latitude.x,
  chl_ds = chl_ugl.x, 
  chl_sensor = chl_ugl.y,
  sensor= sample_type.y,
  lab = lab.x)%>% 
  distinct()
```

```{r}
#Visualize ds comparison by by lab. Reminder that these sensor data have been corrected in the 01_chl_wrangle workbook.
ggplot(chl_comparison_df, aes(x = log(chl_ds), y = log(chl_sensor), color = group)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
  theme_minimal() 
```
